chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Ja'far (peace be upon him) from his father (peace be upon him) from Ali (peace be upon him): Regarding

A man arrives at the people who have already taken the booty (ghanimah), and he was not among those who participated in the fighting. He said, so he said: 'These are the deprived ones, so he ordered that they be given their share.'

key_terms.الْمَحْرُومُونَ: The deprived ones (those who missed the main event)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a soldier who arrives after the battle is won and booty is taken?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq clarifies the distinction between the 'fighting portion' (nawazil) and the general distribution of booty (ghanima), ruling that latecomers are excluded from the combat share but remain eligible for the full division. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that participation in the actual engagement is a prerequisite for the fighting portion, while mere presence at the site of collection suffices for the general share. It highlights the equitable distribution model established by the Ahl al-Bayt to prevent disputes among troops.
